reviewProtocol: Comprehension first solved from article and options before answer keys; then keys, sentence evidence, Chinese explanations and final file hashes checked. Revisions rechecked after weak distractors and unsupported inference prompts were identified.

it.revisionReview: Distractors made parallel; final B1 q2 source combinations rechecked. Full original DGA pages and Istat PDF checked, including dates, licensing, facts, numbers, translations and morphology.

en.revisionReview: Weak distractors revised; final B2 q4 replaced common-knowledge threshold distinction with an article-specific cap question. Whole official bodies and Crown/OGL declarations checked; forecasts and proposals not reported as outcomes.

de.revisionReview: Final question replaced with supported inference about unmeasured sleep interruptions. All five pages of German RKI PDF read. Survey scope, self-report limitations, numeric values, Chinese translations, cloze morphology and licence checked.

freshness.fallback: German RKI original 2026-08-19; 65 days old, not October news.

reserveStatus: Source discovery and intake maintained in all four languages. Not enough independently reviewed varied material for a full week; collected entries remain unreviewed. Three French reserve sources have source/rights review only, not final teaching-content approval.
deduplication: New story IDs, canonical source URLs and text hashes checked against existing articles and candidate queue; no ec-languages-2026-09-26 reuse. French youth creation case article is distinct from the earlier general holiday programme interview.
